Thanks to Keisuke Kawashima, the weird rumors around her started to fade away, and she finds herself attracted to him for his unabashed kindness. Now she's going to go on a date with him to thank him for what he did!? They have a really fun date and Rina confesses her feelings for him. “You have to become a villain to live? … But how do you do that?”

One day, Da-jeong Kim, an ordinary Korean office worker who suddenly possesses the world of a novel. In fact, it is Christine Rosalind, the villain character who dies at the beginning of the novel in the series that she possessed. Perhaps because of Da-jeong’s possession, the original death is avoided, but that is only temporary. In a few moments, you die, and when you die, you return to the starting point of your life. How can I live without dying? The sky throws a clear answer to Da-jeong, who is in trouble. let her be a villain When she becomes a villain she can live without dying. … By the way, can she become a villain that only eats her heart?

“A world collapsing, twisting characters. If you want to live, you have to remember who you are.”

She said she could only live if she was a villain, did she mean that she could only live? After many twists and turns, she heard the voice of a villain, but Da-jeong’s life is hard and painful. It turns out that Christine was born into a civilization of ‘dead or bad’. Unexpected characters appear in front of Da-jeong, who is in such trouble. Raymon Myers, who is the man of the original story and is a perfect match for Christine, Diane Schneider, who was not found in the original, but has a reputation as a vicious witch in the world, and Cordelian Parker, who was possessed by the original author, the female lead of the original and the creator of this world. There, she meets the drop-dead gorgeous Sijin, who whisks her away for an enchanting night together. One night quickly becomes two, and soon they find themselves developing feelings they’d never expected. However, the more they learn about one another, the more they find their past wounds and insecurities returning to haunt them and their relationship. Perhaps what Sijin and Hyunsoo have will be a passing fling, or maybe… it could be the start of something special.

Social status, power, money... Alpha Takamine Taku has everything he could ever wish for... except for one thing: love. 157190.description:
The main character is a 36-year-old female section manager at a general trading company, who in her 20s was called an "oyaji gyaru," but is now a middle manager who understands both her boss's position and the arguments of younger employees. The book is written from the perspective of how the Japanese economy and corporate society are viewed by these women, who are in a position to see the corporate organization from the angle of a clear observer. For example, she points out that the popular phrase "global standards" is often trivialized to mean that one must be proficient in English and information technology, and that many people use this phrase as a shield to try to impose their own standards on others.

This book shows how to relax one's shoulders and laugh at the ridiculousness of Japanese corporate society.

When Akitaka refused their thanks, claiming that they had the wrong person, that's when the very ears and tail that Akitaka had seen on that rainy day popped out from Rio's body. Apparently, Rio is a royalty who's next in line to the throne's succession and he has come to take Akitaka as his princess...!?

While it's unclear if he fully understood the whole thing, Akitaka, in his irritation, kissed Rio who then ran away from the shock of it. However, Rio returned the next day undiscouraged and began to show his affection.

This is the sweet and passionate romance of a pure and dumb wolf prince who's always giving his all in showing his love and the unfriendly and misanthrope vet whose heart eventually opens up from being healed by it.

Suzu, who is cheerful and works hard, meets an incredibly beautiful man by chance in the mansion. A Taisho Cinderella story about the polar opposites Suzu, who is determined and energetic, and her cold, indecisive husband!

Taeyeon and Sangwoo have been married for two years and recently moved to a suburban area. In this new town, she starts her own business as a hairdresser. Everything seems to be going well, except for the fact that Sangwoo is suffering from erectile dysfunction. He understands Taeyeon’s frustration and so he shows his love in a different way: by giving her some “free time” once a week. As more and more customers start to show a special interest in Taeyeon, it seems like her barbershop is becoming a cheater’s paradise…

(Source: Lezhin X)

After a brutal attack destroys the Demonic Sect, fifteen-year-old Lin Shouxi flees to a deserted city. There, he uncovers dark secrets from his past and his link to a mysterious calamity. As the Daoist Sect hunts for him and a powerful artifact, Lin faces new challenges that could change everything.

Ye Fan was reborn as a strange sword with its own upgrade system. The sword is upgraded as the wielder kills with it, and it quickly became known as a powerful cursed weapon that people fought over. Whenever the sword is drawn, a bloody storm will follow. Meanwhile, Ye Fan is just trying to do whatever it takes to transform back into human form…

Despite living in poverty, Madame Curie devoted herself to her research. The story of the efforts and glory of a genius scientist who was the first woman to win the Nobel Prize twice.

(Source: Poplarsha, translated)

"I want to do something for someone." Nightingale decided to become a nurse despite the opposition of those around her. Overcome various problems in a battlefield hospital and think about real nursing for injured people.

The story begins when Hikari, an older neighbor girl, suddenly proposes to the boy Michiru, "Please marry me!" Michiru knew that Hikari was looking to get married, but had no idea that the object of her affections would be him, runs away in bewilderment. Michiru has feelings for her, but his complicated family environment gives him a negative image of marriage. A story of a boy seeking love and salvation unfolds.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

157588.description: Salesman Yukihiko Fujioka (32) has a problem. His relationship with his wife deteriorates due to his erectile dysfunction, and his daughter is cold to him for doing nothing but work - domestic discord. One day, a friend introduces him to a dating app under the guise of "gaining confidence as a man". Yukihiko, who is devoted to his wife, tries to refuse, but his evil instincts take over and he decides to meet a girl who is on the app. There he meets Misuzu, a beautiful woman, and is drawn into the unexpected world of "Insect Parents"...

157589.description:
I wanted my first time, at least, to be with you, the one I love.......

Yusa Saotome, a wealthy, sheltered girl, has feelings for Kage, the eldest son of the Fujiki family, who has served the Saotome family for generations. She and Kage are like family and used to play together when they were young, but as the years went by, they grew apart, and Yusa felt like she has been abandoned. Kage is training to become a butler, and he spends his days doing his job so cooly and efficiently that he is called the "ice butler" by the other servants. Trying to become more independent from her overprotective father, Yusa decides to find a job on her own. But her father set her up with a job and a potential marriage match with Tatsuya, the son of an acquaintance, the president of Makimura & Co. Arisa, determined to be with Kage one way or another, asks Kage to teach her how to properly please a man......!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

After being treated by a doctor for a burn he suffered when he was young, Hideyo Noguchi decided to become a doctor himself and devoted himself to his studies. As a bacteriologist, he discovered the causes of many diseases.

(Source: Poplar-sha, translated)

Note: The 5th volume in Poplar Publishing's Comic World Biography Series (コミック版 世界の伝記).

157592.description:
Galileo changed our fundamental scientific understanding through his observations and experiments. He broadly shared his discoveries, even though it put him in conflict with the Church and caused him to suffer for it. Let's take a look at the life of Galileo, who is called the "Father of Astronomy."

(Source: Poplar-sha, translated)

Note: The 13th volume in Poplar Publishing's Comic World Biography Series (コミック版 世界の伝記).

157593.description:
“Disability is an inconvenience, but it is not a misfortune.” Helen Keller, whose illness left her unable to see and hear. With the support of Mr. Sullivan, she studied and eventually started working for people with disabilities.

(Source: Poplarsha, translated)
synonyms: コミック版世界の伝記

157594.description:
"I want to make my childhood dream come true." Tadataka Inou starts his second life after he turns 50. He studied astronomy, and accomplished the goal of creating a map of Japan.

(Source: Poplarsha, translated)
synonyms: コミック版世界の伝記

157595.description:
At the end of the turbulent Edo period, during the Meiji Restoration, Yukichi Fukuzawa created books and schools based on the idea that "Japan's new era will come from people's education." The foundation of modern education was created to create a country where all people are equal and where they can freely express their opinions.

One day, Hajime Tamachi, a typical bottom-feeding loser, receives a phone call

“Senpai, will you hire me as a housemaid?”

The person who called was "Rena", a friend he had known for 5 years through online games, but he doesn't know her real name or appearance.

Hajime was tempted by those words and went to meet her, and what awaited him was the real thing just as she promised!

157598.description:
Hana Hoshino is a beautiful and innocent 18-year old girl. The man she wants to marry is 33-year-old Sakurai, her stoic and unromantic caretaker. He's the one taking care of her instead of her parents, and ever since they met when she was 14, they have shared everything in life together, both happy and sad. She wants him to see her as a woman, and escape from the relationship of "guardian" and "young lady"! Finally, on her 18th birthday, she makes a proposal to him, but...? The distance between them is a little strange (?!?). A story of love with an age gap of 15 years, involving two opposite people under the same roof.

(Source: Qurie, translated)

157599.description:
"But I've always loved you. Is this feeling love? Or is it instinct…?"

Hinako Sato, a girl from another class, confesses her feelings to Yusei Murata, an Omega. But Hinako is drawn to Yusei for no other reason than that she's an Alpha. A story about true love and longing between a boy and a girl.

Hyuntae Ryu, super-handsome teaching assistant, meets Heewoo Min, a kind, pretty student among a sea of troublemakers. Heewoo is bullied because of his pretty looks and quiet nature. When Hyuntae starts taking care of him, strange emotions spark between the two…

Succubi are the weakest in the underworld... But what if one was able to again sexual control over the Demon King?

Sangyi, an intern at the biggest entertainment company, struggles every day from his boss who's busy stealing his credit, and his jealous teammates. One day, he stumbles upon Insoo performing on the street and is immediately mesmerized by his voice. Sangyi finds Insoo's voice oddly familiar, but he can't seem to remember their bizarre first encounter. Will Sangyi ever find out where he met Insoo for the first time?

Seung-Jeong inherits a shamanic power that only activates through intense pleasure shared with someone on the same wavelength. After a chance encounter at a casino ties him to Ga-Yoon, the two reunite under dangerous circumstances when Ga-Yoon’s adoptive father dies in a suspicious accident. Bound by desire and a dangerous power, they grow closer as they search for the truth.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

157616.description:
Wuyeon is just another young man struggling to make ends meet. Never did he imagine that he'd catch the attention of two wealthy brothers: Jae-ha, who wants to help Wuyeon live in luxury as his personal toy, and Jinwoo, who wants to help Wuyeon escape from his situation. Will either of these men save Wuyeon? More importantly...will Wuyeon need to be saved from them?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a New Years Special and an epilogue.

157618.description:
A dating sim enthusiast wakes up in the body of Reine Waynewright: an adorable otome heroine in a fantasy game! Reine discovers that in this world, she's a lowly F-rank student at the magical Heartfelt Academy, bullied by her classmates and snubbed by her love interests for her lack of talent. Determined to avoid a Bad Ending, Reine resolves to study hard, practice her magic, and pass the exams to increase her rank!

If she grinds hard enough, she may be able to change her fate: make new friends, improve herself, and maybe even fall in love along the way!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.english: I Was Reincarnated as the Heroine on the Verge of a Bad Ending, and I'm Determined to Fall in Love!

157619.description:
Former office worker Reine is delighted to be reincarnated into an otome game as the beautiful protagonist Renee Wainwright. Or she was, until she realizes the game was notorious for hiding its romance routes behind a grueling grind. Worse still, she’s at the very bottom of the academy’s social ladder and on the verge of expulsion, all while she doesn’t even have the protagonist’s memories as aid. Fortunately, Renee’s tough previous life has sharpened her resolve. Armed with an iron will, she’s determined to climb the ranks, win over one of the love interests, and rewrite her fate. If only her elite and estranged older brother would stop inserting himself into every corner of his “amnesiac” sister’s life! Can Renee beat the odds and claw her way to the top? And what is that her brother seems to be hiding?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Do-Hyeon, an incompetent, unemployed vampire, collapses in an alley. He's found by Mu-Hyeok, the successor to a conglomerate, who forces him to work for the company. Do-Hyeon is coached by Mu-Hyeok every day, on the condition that he receives a blood transfusion pack.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

157622.description:
Seeking a new continent, Columbus sets off on an adventurous voyage to Zipangu, the land of gold. He was on the verge of giving up after a long voyage with little food left, when he found the new continent he had dreamed of. His strong conviction and hopeful heart made his dream come true.

(Source: Poplar-sha, translated)

Note: The 11th volume in Poplar Publishing's Comic World Biography Series (コミック版 世界の伝記).

157623.description:
Yuri, a sadist, gets caught while gossiping about Dowon, the team leader. He's usually abusive to his subordinates, and Yuri gets caught up as a new victim in his workplace bullying. However, Yuri turns the tables after he accidentally discovers Dowon's weakness and cunningly uses it to his advantage. Dowon gets a taste of his own medicine when he's forced to do things he wouldn't usually be able to handle~

"Be honest, team leader. This isn't your first time, is it?"

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

The naive girl who is inexperienced at romance falls in love at first sight with a popular boy who is a 5-star level difficult guy!

Hayoon asks his lover Junwoo to take of his shift at his part-time job, but Junwoo realizes what condition Hayoon is in and goes to visit him. As soon as the door opens... Hayoon is definitely in a strange state!

Yoshinaga, her teacher, is a playboy who gets with all the girls! What a scumbag! Hoping to go abroad, Chikako tries hard at English class, and she is actually improving a great deal, but it turns out that her boyfriend wasn't even taking their relationship that seriously. Chikako, heartbroken in despair, sleeps with Yoshinaga...!?

An opposites-attract love story between a girl who is too honest and a boy who can't be honest at all.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

33-year-old Kanako Natsume, who has not been romantically involved with someone for a long time, is perplexed by the sudden confession from Tada, who she thought was a close friend of hers. Meanwhile, her relationship with Saotome, a younger college student, becomes strained. The three are also part of a company trip!
Seeing that Natsume and Tada are on good terms as secretaries together, Saotome gets impatient and ends up getting drunk!
Now he and Natsume are alone! ?

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

157738.description:
Set in Yoshiwara, Edo.
A painter and a courtesan, a secret love that bloomed madly. Souta is bought by the Tsubakiya, the grand brothel in Yoshiwara, on the condition that he will not be discovered to be a man until the end of the year in order to feed his family.
Ten years later, miraculously, he has made a name for himself throughout Yoshiwara as an immensely beautiful Shirotsubaki Hanakai (courtesan) without being found out.
However, when Ryushun, a painter of beautiful women, visits Tsubakiya to paint a portrait of a white camellia courtesan, he instantly discovers that she is a man...!

Shirotsubaki, who has given up her true name to live as a woman, and Ryushun, who is obsessed with painting beautiful women, even to the point of abandoning everything else.
Will they be able to find "love" in the brothel?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

157739.description:
One day, a small boat drifted to a certain remote island. The man who was on board was a yakuza full of wounds. May Tsubame lives with her grandmother who runs a general store on the island. A former office lady who has just returned to the island without finding a place in Tokyo. Tsubame takes care of the wounded drifter without leaving him alone. There's no place for an ex-office worker and a wounded gangster. The days of searching for a place start on a remote island.

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

Just when Rei, who always wears boyish clothes and doesn't know much about fashion or makeup, is at a loss, the "fashion warrior" beauty student Azuma Sengoku appears...!? A new series overflowing with "cute"!

Rintaro puts up with his childhood friend Imari and her weird Occult Club activities. A strange magic circle is drawn in the science lab after school... What is today's experiment, black magic? All of a sudden, what was there has disappeared, and what was flat has become perky...? This is the start of an occult love comedy with a little bit of XX and a reversal of genders!

Lio lost everything she held dear when her home burned down and her grandmother went missing in a suspicious incident years ago. Now, left with nothing to trust but her mysterious powers of illusion, she hopes to discover the truth of her tragic past in a world where nothing is what it seems to be.

"This can't be happening. Let me out!"
A young man happens upon a mysterious house in the woods and is chosen as its warden. Much to his horror, however, he learns that he is forever trapped inside, and the only way to be free is to lure in a replacement—an impossible feat that must be accomplished from within the confines of the house.

Shinichiro Niihama works at a job he hates, for a company with no morals, under a boss who detests him. After years of corporate abuse, one day he collapses. He wakes, only to find—he’s returned to his high school self! Reunited with his once lost mother, Shinichiro realizes he’s leapt back in time. Most importantly, he must get close to the girl he always wished he knew better, Haruka Shijoin, to prevent the tragedy that awaits her!

157753.description:
This spin-off of the hit anime Working for God in a Godless World delivers a terrific twist in Isekai style. Can a sister with God-tier strength find her younger brother in a world without religion? The acclaimed anime that is Working for God in a Godless World, on Crunchyroll, begins when Yukito goes missing after the cult they grew up in enacts some strange ritual. Little do they know; it is that same ritual and their same God that sends him to another world.

But who thought that the older sister he left behind would follow him into this new world? This spin-off of the anime marks the beginning of her adventure that intertwines with her brother's battle. Chiyomaru Urabe has cheat-level super strength, taken from the powers of the God Mitama. She hopes that these powers will be enough to find her missing brother in a world without religion. As she explores the intriguing, yet faithless, land created by Shinya Murata, will super strength be enough to uncover the heavy truth and reach her long-lost brother?

(Source: Titan Manga)

157754.description:
Iris, the daughter of a count, was forced by her sister to go the royal palace in her place, as a fiancee for the tyrant king. The king, who is supposedly cursed with the blood of the silver wolf and is rumored to be a beast himself, will surely bring the kingdom to ruin!? Iris is determined to make it through somehow, but she ends up spending the night with him! Iris thought she was in a desperate situation, but the vicious tyrant is cuddling with her like a big puppy dog!?

"It feels good when you pet me, just like that."

Maybe it has something to with the legend of the "Moon Priestess"…

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

After gaining admission to Han University in Seoul, Yunho is sent to live with his brother, Yunsoo, and his wife, Yoosun. But when he walks on his sexy sister-in-law breastfeeding, he is unable to shake the image from his mind. Coupled with the knowledge that Yunsoo can’t satisfy her carnal desires, Yunho is torn between his duty as a younger brother and his hunger for Yoosun as a red-blooded man. But when he becomes the object of the campus bombshell’s desire, it might be just what he needs to serve as a distraction…

Peter Pan’s Neverland… is a land of fiction, but in this world, people will float into the sky when they feel happy or excited. But just one person, Fuji, is unable to fly into the sky freely. If he were to fly, his feelings for his friend, Nanao would be discovered. Fuji does his best to control his body so it doesn’t float, but Nanao, always his happy, floating self, comes to visit Fuji…

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

A bike action that depicts the activities of Kosuke Katayama, also known as "Sepahan," who drives his brother's keepsake bike Mach III. Kosuke Katayama, a high school student called Sepahan, manages the bike Mach III of his late brother Shinji, who was the legendary head of a runaway tribe, with exquisite techniques. One day, Sepahan, who is worried about his sister Maki who went to a runaway rally, skips Mach III and gets into a coffee shop where Maki should be ...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

157760.description:
Ah-cheng and Cheng-hsin are good friends with opposite personalities. Nini is Ah-cheng's beloved sister, and Cheng-hsin treated her like his own sister, too. Their happy life together lasted until Cheng-hsin suddenly transferred away during high school and they lost touch with each other.

Ten years later, Nini enters university, only to meet Cheng-hsin again by chance. That was when she found out the kind Cheng-hsin has been hiding a painful secret, and Nini became determined to help Cheng-hsin's dream come true.

(Source: WEBTOON, translated)

157761.description:
Ami Satou works for Cobara, a company that specializes in sweets. While she may be good at sales, her confidence in pretty much everything else is low, which is why she hasn't even thought about dating since college. Instead, she fills up her imagination with romantic scenes from shoujo manga.

When she meets Alain Giraud, a handsome, older French man in charge of a new project she's assigned to work on, she begins to struggle to keep that romantic imagination in check... especially with Alain being so overly friendly! Ami keeps reminding herself that it's just because he's French, but will she be able to resist his romantic charm?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

When she is lost in an unfamiliar place, a man with red hair and pierced ears suddenly approaches her...!? This new life of expectation and anxiety was not supposed to be like this...!?

Living together under one roof is a girl seeking affection and a robot who has no feelings. Riona lost her mother at an early age and was raised by her father. She goes to an all-girls school where she has many friends and a special "girlfriend", but her busy father is always away from home, and she feels a little lonely. One day, Riona witnesses her father having sex with "Forti," a robot he purchased as a "maid" to do the housework.......? Talented young wizard Pram is often misunderstood, clumsy knight Peter wants to feel needed, and Princess Ellie seems to have a split personality. What will happen when these three misfits come together in this wild fairytale adventure?

(Source: Manta)

157775.description:
"Faithful to our instincts, we are animals! Come take a look at our animal high school lives."

In the middle of the forest, there is a all-boys school. Students learn and live regular lives…That is, if they can survive until the end! This school isn’t just some ordinary school for humans, but rather a place animals go to educate themselves in the art of being human. We follow Oh Da-Ram (meaning "Squirrel") as he starts school in the first year herbivores are admitted into the student body. Insanity ensues as his best friend, Kim Neuk-Dae (meaning "Wolf") continually tries to get a little taste of Da-Ram’s tail, a new baby duckling joins his family, and his classmates behave like the rambunctious animals they are. Is anyone really ready to be human?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

157776.description:
The heartwarming tale of a winter wonderland.

This little snow sprite is looking for fun, friends, and a place where it belongs — and not even a grumpy old man can stop it! As winter deepens and the snow sprite burrows itself into his life, the old man discovers a joyous warmth that he could have never expected.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Old Man and the Snow Sprite

157777.description:
I must harvest the power of love!

When a magical potion that can transform any living organism into a human goes awry, it’s up to Sarang the Chameleon to harvest the power of true love and save the Demon World. But can a chameleon masquerading as a human truly blend in with society and accomplish her goal?

Appraiser Laurent was kicked out from his guild "Golden Hawk." It was a result of one-sided jealousy from the guild leader, Lucius.

Feeling hurt and crushed by the sudden dismissal, a female mage named Lilianne gave him a helping hand. Together with her, he decided to create a new guild to mess with Lucius.

Eventually, those talents that Laurent found through his appraisal skill will create the strongest guild.

Shrouded in mystery, He Lu harbors a closely guarded secret that has made him a loner among his colleagues. But He Lu's tightly-wound, solitary existence takes an unexpected turn upon crossing paths with the enigmatic Song Qi. As these two worlds collide, the reclusive He Lu finds himself stirred by unfamiliar feelings, gradually awakening from his self-imposed isolation to discover the transformative power of being cherished by another.

(Source: WebComics)

157786.description:
Kurashina is a high school student who has a complex about being a Dom. He thinks Isshiki, the student body president with an imposing figure, is a Dom and has a one-sided inferiority complex.

One day, Kurashina finds Isshiki collapsed on campus. Unable to overlook his unusually weakened appearance, he takes care of him. But when Isshiki confides in Kurashina the surprising fact that he is a Sub, Kurashina feels guilty for his behavior because of a misunderstanding that has led him to behave coldly.

Thinking that Isshiki had no particular partner and was feeling ill due to a lack of communication with a Dom, Kurashina then suggested having a light play with him as his way of making amends.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

157787.description:
Wim Strauss is a “granting caster”—a support mage who can increase the strength of his allies through the power of his spells. It’s a useful talent, but since it can’t be used directly in battle, it gets zero respect from the other members of his party. As far as they’re concerned, support magic is dead weight. It isn’t long before they toss him out on his ear, leaving Wim to wonder if his career as an adventurer is over.

Lucky for Wim, he has one big chance: his childhood friend Heidemarie is able to get him an audition with her elite A-rank party, Nachtlibelle. The two of them know his magic is good for more than just menial backup, but now he’ll have to prove it. It’s time to show the world that support mages can do more than just stand on the back lines!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

A pious sister of the faith who belongs to a certain religious cult devotes her body to the local villagers, the church minister, and to her God.

He lived his days in a daze until, on the remote live-stream screen of a poor county high school, he saw Lin Qinhe from the prestigious Wenhua High School thousands of kilometers away.

For him, living at the bottom of a well, it was the first glimpse of the moon in the sky.

But when he exhausted all his strength to climb out of the well and trekked through mountains and rivers towards the moon, he discovered that the star beside the moon was originally meant to be his place.

Tao Xi wanted Lin Qinhe, along with the missing affection that should have been his.

Her girlfriend cheated on her, work is stressful, and her parents are badgering her to get married. It's almost too much to bear, like she's just gone from one hell to another. The humans named the area inhabited by the demons the "Demon Country" and dispatched an army to defeat them. Thus began a war of over 100 years between the human and demon nations. Originally from a wealthy family with abundant resources, his extreme misfortune led to his own father's bankruptcy. Furthermore, he was outspoken. In an interview, when a reporter asked him which female celebrity he liked the most, he blurted out "Zhu Yilin," getting cursed by Zhu Yilin's fans and trending on social media with tens of thousands of personal attacks. Not only does he become drawn to her bizarre stench, he also begins to pay close attention to her seemingly odd behavior. After being reminded of harpies - the half-woman, half-bird beasts of Greek mythology - during a lesson in class, Sawa begins to think Kawahori might actually be one of those mythological beasts herself.

2. Ame no Houmonsha (雨の訪問者)
Itoi is an office lady who's getting up there in years, yet is perfectly content with being single. One day, as the rainy season suddenly arrives, she comes home to a little girl she has never seen before in her apartment...

3. Undine (ウンディーネ)

157938.description:
After losing his father in a tragic accident, Shinobu Iijima and his younger sister Megumi are taken in by their father's old friend, Ayumu. Shinobu works hard in the hopes of starting a new life for himself. Megumi, and a mobile game called La Vita Online, are the only things keeping him afloat. One day, Ayumu reveals his true intentions of tearing Shinobu down and getting his hands on Megumi. But just after Shinobu learns that Ayumu deleted all of his game data in La Vita, their high-rise apartment catches on fire and Shinobu falls to his death, Megumi in tow.

He wakes up in a strange new world... and realizes he's been reincarnated into the world of La Vita Online. An announcement from the devs tells him that Ayumu is already there, and a countdown to Megumi's arrival is ticking. Shinobu vows to protect Megumi after she arrives at any cost, even if it means he has to crawl his way up from level 1 to fend off all the other reincarnated players.
